source.name: HDB resale flat prices, 1990 onwards
source.dateBasis: Approval date for 1990–2012-02; registration date for 2012-03 onwards, following source dataset partitions.
source.aggregation: Annual median transaction price and count by exact normalized block + street name; repeated independently for each flat type. Half-dollar medians are rounded to the nearest whole SGD. These are historical transaction observations, not current-value estimates.

streetCodeCrosswalk.method: A source street code is linked only when every existing-building block carrying that code has one identical street name in common among its HDB Property Information matches. Codes with missing rows or multiple common street candidates are omitted.
